ports.adaptation: GPU ID rendering and asynchronous one-pixel readback with a polled fence. Click a cube to select it; Space pauses rotation. Twelve cubes replace the original mesh collection. A full-resolution ID target and one-pixel query replace bgfx's tight 8x8 picking projection and majority vote. The interactive loop never waits for GPU completion.

Adapted RSM: 256x256 RGBA16F position/normal/flux MRTs, explicit camera position G-buffer, point-light PCF9 shadows and 64-sample fullscreen indirect gather. Cornell room and six boxes replace 222 upstream objects. Original uses 512x512 compact targets and 1024 individual sphere draws, not instancing. ImGui exposes amount/radius/azimuth/elevation with upstream ranges. Amount uses direct/indirect mix; unrelated ambient and tone mapping removed. Radius/falloff, formats, camera, shadow filtering and scene remain different; timings are not equal-work binding comparisons. See docs/bgfx-sky-rsm-audit.md.

Four CPU emitters, particle lifetime and Bezier/gravity motion, CPU depth sorting, and one instanced GPU billboard draw with the original sprite. Simulation stays on the CPU as in bgfx examples/common/ps; it is not the compute N-body example. M cycles sphere, hemisphere, circle, disc and rectangle; A switches additive/premultiplied-alpha blending; Space pauses; R resets. This adapts emitter shapes and motion, rather than reproducing every upstream curve, material and ImGui parameter. Capacity is 4096 particles.

Normal, parallax, steep parallax and interpolated parallax occlusion mapping on the GPU, using the original diffuse/normal/height textures. M cycles flat, normal, parallax, steep and POM; Space pauses rotation; R resets it. A single rotating quad makes displacement easy to compare. Maps are decoded offline to RGBA8 base levels; the shader explicitly samples LOD 0 inside divergent ray marching. It does not reproduce upstream mip filtering, editable light/material controls or scene layout.

Multiple vertex streams: positions in slot 0, colors in slot 1, explicit SDL vertex attributes and 121 rotating cubes. M switches only the color buffer; Space pauses; R resets rotation. The port uses an expanded triangle list instead of the upstream indexed strip. Position data is unchanged when switching colors; streams are never interleaved on the CPU.
